name: E-Invoice
description: Issues electronic invoices (hoa don dien tu) when an order completes. Country legal requirements are encapsulated behind a pluggable profile strategy, with a Vietnam profile aligned to Nghinh dinh 254/2026/ND-CP and Thong tu 91/2026/TT-BTC. Invoices are viewable from the customer email, the My Account order detail page, and a REST endpoint.
author: Puleeno Nguyen
